snippet.title: Gradius II (Famicom/NES) Full Run with No Deaths (No Miss)
snippet.description:
Gradius II
System & Settings: Famicom (NES)

This video shows a full, no-death playthrough of Gradius II for the Nintendo Famicom.  This game was only released in Japan and never made it to the US.

Stage Listing:
0:00 - Start
0:26 Stage 1 - Burning Heat
3:30 Stage 2 - Alien
7:05 Stage 3 - Volcano
8:51 Stage 4 - Red Crystal Cage
12:42 Stage 5 - The Old Stone Age
16:14 Stage 6 - Boss Rush
19:24 Stage 7 - Fortress
24:04 Stage 8 - Something Ghostly
25:30 Final Boss - Gofer
26:29 Ending + Credits

Note: In order to play this game on a US NES, you will need a 60 to 72 pin converter.

As with all of my videos this was played on a real, original NES (using a Famicom converter).  No emulators, save-states, cheats, hacks, or other BS!!
